title: Normalized unbounded proper/open interchange: pasting and the arbitrary-base-change cube
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. On the ordinary unbounded small-etale module derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], write $P_v=v^{-1}$ for exact inverse image, $R_v=Rv_*$ for total derived direct image, and $J_j=Dj_!$ for degreewise open extension [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact, lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact]. Let
$$Q=\begin{array}{ccc}U&\xrightarrow{k}&V\\ r\downarrow&&\downarrow p\\ W&\xrightarrow{i}&Z\end{array},\qquad pk=ir,$$
be a commutative square of arbitrary schemes, with $p,r$ proper and $i,k$ open [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion]. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $\Gamma_Q:J_iR_r\xrightarrow{\sim}R_pJ_k$ with this normalization: for a K-injective representative $I$ of an input on $U$ and a K-injective resolution $k_!I\to H$, its component is represented by
$$i_!r_*I\xrightarrow{\theta_Q}p_*k_!I\longrightarrow p_*H.$$
Here $\theta_Q$ is the canonical sheaf proper-support identification: both sheaves are the subsheaf of $(ir)_*I=(pk)_*I$ of sections with support proper over the target, extended by zero along the indicated open. K-injectives and total derived direct image are as in [def-pur-kinjective-complex, lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived]. For Cartesian $Q$ [def-pc-fibre-product], $\Gamma_Q$ is exactly the unit--open-base-change--counit map of [lem-sf-etale-proper-open-tensor-square].
For vertically stacked squares $Q_1,Q_2$ of this kind, with middle open $i_1$, bottom open $i_2$, left proper maps $r_1,r_2$ and right proper maps $p_1,p_2$,
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(R_{p_2}\Gamma_{Q_1})\circ(\Gamma_{Q_2}R_{r_1}).$$
For horizontally adjacent squares with top opens $k,l$, bottom opens $i,j$ and proper verticals $r,p,q$,
$$\Gamma_{Q_2Q_1}=(\Gamma_{Q_2}J_k)\circ(J_j\Gamma_{Q_1}).$$
Insert the canonical direct-image and open-extension compositors; squares with identity proper or identity open edges give their canonical identity comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition, lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition].
For any scheme map $b:Z_1\to Z$, base change every vertex of $Q$ over $Z$; write $Q_1$ for the new square and $a:V_1\to V$, $c:W_1\to W$, $d:U_1\to U$ for the projections. Let $\beta_i:P_bJ_i\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{i_1}P_c$ and $\beta_k:P_aJ_k\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{k_1}P_d$ be the inverses of the open-unit-normalized mates of [lem-asd-open-base-change-unit-mate]. With the unbounded unit--square--counit exchanges of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange],
$$(R_{p_1}\beta_k)\circ(\operatorname{Ex}_pJ_k)\circ P_b(\Gamma_Q)
=(\Gamma_{Q_1}P_d)\circ(J_{i_1}\operatorname{Ex}_r)\circ(\beta_iR_r).$$
This is an equality of the specified natural transformations $P_bJ_iR_r\to R_{p_1}J_{k_1}P_d$. No quasi-compactness of the opens, Noetherianity, boundedness, constructibility or Tor-amplitude assumption is imposed, and $Q$ need not be Cartesian.

Shape: one commit with the item and the report only, no new nodes. The statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to the live unsplit node that NC created on 2026-10-24, so nothing was weakened, and this is a first split, not a re-split. proof_deps equals the union of the steps' uses, the dependency graph has no cycle, no cited node is merged and no SGA source is cited. Statement: it is Stacks 0F7B case (b) for a finite coefficient ring A, specialised to open immersions (separated and locally quasi-finite, so no quasi-compactness is needed), together with 0F7C/0F7D pasting and the 0F7F cube. The coefficient category is constant-A module sheaves on the small etale site, unbounded D(T_et,A), which is Stacks' D(X_et,Lambda). The base-change maps are the unit-square-counit mates of def-kun-unbounded-exchange, and beta_i, beta_k are the inverses of the unit-normalized mates; this matches 0F7F. I checked that both sides of the cube and both pasting laws are well typed, and that the four side faces of the cube are Cartesian. Steps: I checked every step against the full statements of all 28 cited nodes and against the Stacks text. Step 1: lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition applies, since open immersions and proper maps are separated and locally of finite type. Step 2 follows the local argument of 0F7B(b): restriction to an affine open B keeps K-injectives and injectives, proper base change, the fibre-dimension bound on quasi-compact B, the cd bound 2d for torsion sheaves (A is finite, and the module/abelian comparison applies), and acyclicity of open-extended injectives with no Cartesian hypothesis. Step 3: Stacks 07K7 by naturality of alpha, then the stalk test; the case of a K-injective without injective terms is handled by homotopy equivalences, which I verified. Step 4: independence and naturality from the Hom bijection and the resolution cocycle. Step 5: I verified the sheaf identity: in the Cartesian case the source is supported on k(U), so k_! adjunction reduces both maps to the r-counit; the mate bijection then gives the Gamma of lem-sf-etale-proper-open-tensor-square. Steps 6-7 follow 0F7C/0F7D; I checked the compositor normalization and the naturality of theta, and the identity-edge cases hold. Steps 8-10 follow 0F7F; I expanded both paths and they agree by the step-8 sheaf cube and the step-9 homotopy h a^{-1}rho beta^{-1} ~ sigma k1_!u. Neither exchange is cancelled. Small cases tested: empty U, identity edges, a non-Cartesian clopen-component square, and a base that is not quasi-compact. Tool uses: I accept all 16 declared tool_uses as generic black boxes. Duplicates: lem-amb-unbounded-proper-open-interchange is the Noetherian special case of this item; the other candidates are bounded-below, Weil-sheaf or pro-etale. None states this result. For the maintainer: the Noetherian lem-amb node could later be merged into or cite this item, and blueprint.from.node is null, inherited from NC's creation of the item.
